params.body:
The trend page's graph drops patterns and tensions in `TrendCard::measuredGraph`, because their names are a model's and nobody reads them before they go up. The pipeline now sends them as unnamed points (gentells-pipeline, `trend-graph.mjs`), the way the home page's showcase graph has drawn them all along. This keeps them, unnamed.

## What changes

- `TrendCard::measuredGraph`: a pattern or tension node keeps only its layer, `{id: 'pattern-N' | 'tension-N', type}`, whatever arrives: no title, no name, and a numbered id, since a real id carries the name. Edges follow the new ids. Insight, concept and signal nodes are unchanged; any other type is still dropped.
- The caption under the graph: "The signals at the bottom, the concepts they share, the tensions and patterns they form, the trend on top."
- The graph script already draws a node without a title as its layer only (as for concepts below Decode), so no JavaScript changes.

## Tests

`InsightGraphTest`: patterns and tensions reach the page as numbered points and their names and real ids never do, even for a Decode reader; `measuredGraph` keeps a pattern as `pattern-1` with its edge and drops an unknown type. The full suite passes apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree.
params.title: Trend graph: keep patterns and tensions as unnamed points
